labelingPolicy: Multi-label human-impact audit of the final recognition-2.4.1 output. Equivalent merged tasks are not missing. NO_ISSUE means none of the five audited issue types is present; it does not certify every field.

issueDefinitions.MISSING_TASK: An explicit user action is absent or its predicate changes the required behavior.
issueDefinitions.MISSING_TIMEPOINT: An explicit, relative, vague, or superseded time fact is absent.
issueDefinitions.WRONG_TIME_ROLE: A time has the wrong business role, unsupported precision, or unsafe active/superseded state.
issueDefinitions.MISSING_AMBIGUITY: A material condition or uncertainty is not surfaced for confirmation.
issueDefinitions.EVENT_TASK_CONFUSION: An event and an actionable task are conflated, or an explicit event is lost into task-only structure.
issueDefinitions.NO_ISSUE: None of the five audited issue types applies.
